visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a close-up of a man with a shaved head and a top-knot, looking directly into the camera with a subtle smirk. He is wearing a white and beige bomber-style jacket. He holds up two rectangular stickers in his left hand; the top one is black with white Japanese text, and the bottom one is white with a stylized black rabbit logo and the red text 'BiBi Sama'. The background is blurred, showing hints of green foliage and a street. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-full shot from behind the man as he stands outdoors. He is wearing a light-colored satin-finish Sukajan (souvenir jacket). The back of the jacket features intricate embroidery: a large central design with Japanese text, a character riding a scooter, and various symbols including stars and clouds. In the background, blurred residential buildings and trees are visible under natural daylight. (3) The scene cuts to another shot from behind, now showing the man in a dark grey or black knit sweater. The lower half of the sweater has a brown and blue landscape pattern with gold star-shaped embroidery scattered across the upper back. He turns his head slightly to look back over his shoulder toward the camera. (4) The camera cuts to a front-facing medium shot of the man in the same dark knit sweater. He uses both hands to point at a large embroidered patch on his chest featuring two characters on a yellow moon background. He makes an exaggerated facial expression, wrinkling his nose and pouting his lips in a comical 'stink face'. (5) A close-up shot follows, showing the man's hand holding a printed acrylic standee or keychain shaped like a bird character (Elizabeth from Gintama) wearing the same knit sweater. His face is visible in the background, making a shocked expression with his tongue slightly out. (6) The final shot is a close-up of the man's lower leg and foot. He is wearing a pair of Gintama-themed socks featuring a character's face and a traditional landscape pattern. He is wearing a dark grey, textured clog-style shoe (Croc) with a small green charm attached. He holds another pair of packaged socks next to his leg.
